identity.title: Lean Agent Execution Governance
identity.objective: Replace universal independent pre-implementation certification with mechanically derived FAST, RUNTIME, and PROTECTED governance tracks. Require one canonical prompt authority mirror equal to the spec before routing so prompt authority cannot be understated in machine data. FAST and RUNTIME use deterministic prompt/spec/readiness gates without an independent certificate; PROTECTED retains exact immutable certificate behavior. Preserve exact-diff enforcement, required validation failure semantics, final Side review, historical certified-package compatibility, and every product/runtime/trading boundary. WP171G itself voluntarily selects PROTECTED and passes the legacy strict workflow one final time.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP171G. Only workflow-governance documentation, the local/offline readiness helper, its direct tests, package evidence, and repo-truth/status records change. No product source, workflow YAML, dependency, lock file, credential, network runtime, Hermes runtime, strategy, paper, execution, or live state is created or migrated.

items.condition: FAST/RUNTIME complete deterministic prompt/spec/readiness checks with no open decisions; PROTECTED completes the independent exact-hash twelve-lens certificate. WP171G itself uses the legacy PROTECTED meaning.
The user explicitly authorizes implementation after track-specific readiness; readiness remains non-authority and never grants AUTHORIZED.
The executor implements only the governed scope and reruns deterministic readiness after permitted corrections; PROTECTED semantic edits require independent recertification.

evidence_plan.reason: R001-R010 map one-to-one to the prompt requirement plan: routing, certificate compatibility, DRAFTABILITY_PASS semantics, correction, validation policy, efficiency, contract compilation, protected boundaries, repo truth, and final publication.

FAST and RUNTIME can pass without certificates, PROTECTED cannot, valid historical certificates remain accepted, and protected hash changes invalidate readiness

a same-envelope FAST prompt/spec correction reruns deterministic readiness without certificate while a protected semantic change still requires recertification
track-specific validation policy retains failure blocking and mandatory final Side review for every track
canonical guidance limits repeated broad suites and reviewer personas while retaining one stable-candidate authoritative validation
FAST and RUNTIME require deterministic smoke of every existing interface literal before package freeze
PROTECTED credentials, execution, live, and Risk 4 boundaries remain certificate-gated and cannot be weakened by prompt selection
repo truth records WP171 merged, WP171G as the one-time governance bridge, and WP172 Alpha plus Executable Edge as next and unstarted
